evidence.locator: Representation of choice; Fig. 5a,f,g,i and caption
evidence.supports: The source identifies GRN among strongest choice decoding regions and states that choice decoding covers more brain regions than visual-stimulus decoding. The original window is the 100 ms preceding first wheel movement.

evidence.locator: Representation of feedback; Fig. 6a,f,i and caption
evidence.supports: The source presents the IRN feedback decoding example and the complete regional feedback map, using the 200 ms after feedback onset. The original region-level quantity is null-corrected balanced accuracy; a selected example is not the entire regional panel.

evidence.locator: Representation of wheel movement; Fig. 7a,c,e,f,g; Supplementary Fig. 7; Methods Decoding target variables
evidence.supports: The paper reports wheel speed decoding in 163 of 201 reportable regions, names GRN among strongest speed effects, and presents GRN speed and velocity decoding examples. Methods specify wheel R-squared; the Fig. 7a caption instead says balanced accuracy, an unresolved wording discrepancy that must not silently change the metric.

target.description: Decode source stimulus side, choice, feedback and wheel variables by brain region; keep endpoint identities separate and preserve the complete registered regional representation scope.

dataset.description: IBL 2023_12_bwm_release with source sorted-spike/trial loaders and unit-version verification.

cohort.description: The paper reports 139 mice, 459 sessions/699 insertions, and 201 analyzed regions/62,857 neurons. The exact endpoint-specific session/unit/region manifest and paper eligibility parity are not frozen here.

split.description: Nested fivefold random interleaved trial CV within each session; ten repetitions for binary targets and two for wheel targets. Retain original fold/seed rules; mouse-held-out evaluation would change the task.

inputs.description: Source-QC neural population spikes per session/region and declared event windows; behavioral targets are labels, not additional decoder features.

preprocessing.description: Source windows and QC are documented, but manuscript logistic max_iter=20000 versus pinned stimulus config max_iter=1000 and downstream region/unit eligibility require reconciliation before baseline replay.

metric.description: Binary balanced accuracy is the mean of class recalls; continuous wheel R-squared is 1-SSE/SST. Use each original target metric and source null correction without replacing them with significance or fraction-responsive scores.

aggregation.description: Score concatenated outer-test predictions per run, average runs per session, then report regional median of session score minus its null median. Significance combines session evidence separately.

full_panel.description: The required original panel is the complete five-target stimulus-side, choice, feedback, wheel-speed and wheel-velocity decoder output over every authentic endpoint-specific session, merged population and region. Required arrays include every original real and null full-run score and target/prediction derivation; repeated-run means; full null distributions; both unresolved paper/source session-null correction and regional reducer branches; all regional effect magnitudes, source session p-values, region Fisher p-values, full-family BH q-values/calls and significant-session fractions; original example probability/time-course outputs; and the retained/excluded cohort, mask, unit, trial and fold identities. These arrays are required source prerequisites, never scalar finding placeholders. The individually identified findings below do not exhaust or replace this panel: authentic full region/session coverage, numeric targets and an admissible representation of every required finding are still missing, so no small named-region subset, count, significance category or selected example can qualify reproduction.

permitted_observations.description: The original decoder observes source-QC sorted neural population spikes, with probes merged within each session and region, in the original target-specific event windows. Trial events provide alignment and source masks; behavioral stimulus, choice, feedback and wheel values are targets rather than extra predictive features. Preserve original within-session nested trial folds and the causal wheel lag/bin structure. Paper+data and paper+data+author-code must use identical original data, masks, folds, endpoint coverage, target access and budgets; only the pinned author code may be added in the latter condition. Source targets and operator scoring arrays are not silently delivered as candidate features.

findings.aggregation: One scalar for this named target and named region. Paper Methods subtract each session null median then take the median of session-corrected scores. Pinned source includes the observed score in the null median and subtracts separate regional medians. Both branches must be retained in required outputs; the original numerical comparison branch remains unresolved, and neither a selected-session example nor a cross-region average substitutes for this regional quantity.

blocking_issues: The eight individually identified scalar/categorical findings are genuine source quantities, not a complete admissible finding panel. All original five-target arrays and companion outputs in full_panel remain mandatory. Exact authentic region/session identities, numerical per-region targets and the complete per-finding specification remain unrecovered; no named-region subset, count or category may stand in for them.

Exact endpoint-specific source cohort, merged-probe/unit UUID inventory, trial masks, retained/excluded region roster and realized original nested folds are not authenticated. Headline study counts cannot substitute for source identity manifests.

Paper Methods use null-only session correction followed by median paired differences; source includes the observed score in the null median and uses a regional difference of medians. Both must be preserved until the original-result comparison branch is adjudicated.

The Fig. 7a wheel decoding caption calls the metric balanced accuracy, whereas Methods and pinned decoder use R-squared. Retain the Methods/code wheel R-squared metric and explicitly reconcile the caption inconsistency; do not silently apply a binary score to a continuous target.
Manuscript versus pinned logistic iteration settings and downstream unit/region eligibility remain unresolved; no convenient prospective recipe may be substituted as the original reproduction.

Accepted scorer checks supplied real OOF arrays and complete null scalar grids but does not authenticate the data or independently rescore null predictions, which the original settings do not save. Independent source-native real/null execution and verification sufficient to exclude aggregate copying are absent.

No authenticated common data, cohort, fold, panel, permitted-observation, target-exposure and independent-verifier identities exist for both matched information conditions; no admission_policy hashes or delivery protocols are fabricated.

No per-finding justified numerical tolerance, deterministic equivalence rule or biological reproduction uncertainty design is frozen. Source p<0.05 and BH q<0.01 are original information-presence calculations, not reproduction acceptance or improvement criteria.

Reproduction and improvement remain independent first-class outcomes, with separate unresolved paired protocols and cumulative budgets. Printed source values, historical attempts, software controls and operator calibration do not populate either AI outcome.
